The '''taozin''', also known as a "force dragon' was a giant annelid with many arms and legs native to the [[Jungle moon of Va'art|jungle moon]] of [[Va'art]]. Capable of spitting silken webbing to entrap its prey, taozins' natural shell armor was almost completely resistant to [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]<ref name="POTJ" /> and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. Their translucent body served to diffuse energy based weapons. A lightsaber in contact with the shell could retain enough cohesion to hurt the creature, but not seriously wound it.<ref name=":0" /> 

[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] creatures, taozin could interfere with the sense abilities of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], making them appear invisible in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="TJP" /> [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] would describe attempting to sense one as "almost like encountering a surface so slick that one could find no purchase on it."<ref name=":0" />

Finding their way all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], taozin were thought to be extinct until [[Darsha Assant]], [[Lorn Pavan]], and [[I-5YQ]] stumbled across one circa [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] while fleeing from Darth Maul in the depths of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] it by cutting the bridge that he and the taozin were on, letting it fall into the chasm below while Maul escaped.<ref name=":0" />

[[Taozin amulet|Taozin nodules]] were small, roughly spherical objects taken from the skin of a taozin which could maintain the same Force-disguise that a living taozin could, causing wielders to be nearly undetectable in the force.<ref name="TJP" /> In 32 BBY, I-5YQ took a nodule from the creature they encountered in the depths and gave it to Pavan. Pavan would use it to hide his presence during his unsuccessful assassination attempt on Maul.<ref name=":0">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> Similarly, in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], [[Gregar Typho]] obtained a nodule from a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] apothecary, while preparing for an attempt to assassinate [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. The apothecary considered it a "rare curiosity."<ref name=":1" />

After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the members of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] were equipped with taozin amulets, which would mask their presence while on the hunt for rogue Jedi.<ref name=":1">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
